title: Oxalate Biosynthesis and Ascorbate Recycling Kinetics under Dynamic LED Spectrum in Spinacia oleracea
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Spinach (*Spinacia oleracea*) accumulates anti-nutritional oxalic acid in mesophyll tissue. We quantified the metabolic flux between L-ascorbate breakdown and oxalic acid accumulation under blue (450nm) vs red (660nm) LED regimes. High blue photon flux increased L-galactono-1,4-lactone dehydrogenase activity while down-regulating oxalate oxidase, providing a spectral protocol for low-oxalate spinach production.
key_findings: Blue LED ratio of 25% reduced mesophyll oxalate accumulation by 28.4% compared to monochromatic red.
L-ascorbate pool expanded by 34.2% while total soluble oxalate decreased from 9.2 mg/g to 6.6 mg/g FW.
Enzyme kinetics showed Km = 0.42 mM for L-galactono-1,4-lactone dehydrogenase under 250 μmol/m²/s PPFD.
